column1: # Every page in Codex's documentation index, as of the snapshot date.
# Same purpose as claude-doc-pages.tsv: the allowlist separating Codex doc
# citations from Claude ones, and the DENOMINATOR for the codex coverage map
# TWO EXTRACTION TRAPS, both measured 2026-08-29, both of which silently
# UNDERCOUNT the corpus — which is the direction that hides pages nobody has read:
#  1. An index entry may carry a QUERY STRING: five of them are spelled
#     `\.md\)` drops all five and loses two whole slugs (`developer-commands`,
#  2. `windows/windows-app` is listed TWICE by upstream's own index, so data
#     lines and unique pages are not the same number. The previous snapshot said
#     "139 pages" while holding 138, and a denominator that counts a page twice
#     overstates coverage by exactly the page nobody opened. This file's own
#     count is now checked against its unique slugs by
#     `scripts/check-coverage-map.ts`; the duplicate is kept as ONE line here and
#     is pinned as two legitimate map rows in that script.
# `llms-full.txt` is excluded deliberately: it is a corpus dump, not a page.
